mapper.sql: SELECT s.pi_no, s.factory_code, s.bill_no, s.alloc_customer customer_code, COALESCE(f.mes_enabled, 0) mes, s.alloc_qty qty, s.alloc_suspended suspended FROM sn_bill_stat s LEFT JOIN sn_factory f ON f.factory_code = s.factory_code WHERE s.factory_code IS NOT NULL AND s.alloc_qty > 0 AND s.pi_no = #{pi} AND (s.pi_no LIKE #{q} OR s.bill_no LIKE #{q}) AND COALESCE(f.mes_enabled, 0) = #{mes}
mapper.select: ORDER BY s.pi_no DESC, s.factory_code, s.bill_no LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT i.bill_seq, i.material_code, MAX(i.attach_no) attach_no, MAX(i.length_text) length_text, COUNT(*) qty, SUM(i.suspend IS NOT NULL) suspended FROM sn_item i GROUP BY i.bill_seq, i.material_code ORDER BY i.bill_seq, i.material_code
mapper.sql: SELECT factory_code, bill_seq, material_code, MAX(attach_no) attach_no, MAX(length_text) length_text, seq_pi_no, MIN(seq_dec) s, MAX(seq_dec) e, SUBSTRING(MIN(CONCAT(LPAD(seq_dec, 20, '0'), sn)), 21) start_sn, SUBSTRING(MAX(CONCAT(LPAD(seq_dec, 20, '0'), sn)), 21) end_sn, COUNT(*) qty, MAX(suspend) suspend FROM (SELECT i.factory_code, i.bill_seq, i.material_code, i.attach_no, i.length_text, i.status, i.seq_pi_no, i.seq_dec, i.sn, i.suspend, i.seq_dec - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.factory_code, i.bill_seq, i.material_code, i.seq_pi_no ORDER BY i.seq_dec) grp FROM sn_item i ) t GROUP BY factory_code, bill_seq, material_code, seq_pi_no, grp
mapper.select: ORDER BY bill_seq, seq_pi_no, s, factory_code LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT i.seq_pi_no, i.seq_dec FROM sn_item i AND i.sn = #{sn} LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT i.attach_no FROM sn_item i

SELECT i.id, i.sn, i.rule_version_id, i.seq_dec, i.seq_pi_no, i.factory_code factory_code, f.factory_name factory_name, i.customer_code, i.pi_no, i.bill_no, i.bill_seq, i.material_code, i.attach_no, i.length_text, i.status, i.delivery_mode, i.delivery_batch_no FROM sn_item i LEFT JOIN sn_factory f ON f.factory_code = i.factory_code
AND (i.bill_seq > #{afterSeq} OR (i.bill_seq = #{afterSeq} AND (i.seq_pi_no > #{afterPi} OR (i.seq_pi_no = #{afterPi} AND i.seq_dec > #{afterDec}))))
ORDER BY i.bill_seq, i.seq_pi_no, i.seq_dec LIMIT 5000
